name: V U This
summary: Show selected PDFs, photos, slides exported as PDF, text and useful screen content on a TV or projector, controlled from a phone, tablet or laptop browser.
quick_start: Open https://vuthis.com in the browser on the TV or projector display, or on its already-connected computer/player.
Scan the displayed connection QR code with the controller phone, or open https://vuthis.com/r on a phone, tablet or laptop and enter the screen code.
Choose the relevant content feature and show the selected item.

connection.display: Usable browser on the screen itself or an already-connected computer/player.
connection.controller: Phone, tablet or laptop browser connected with the displayed QR code or screen code.
connection.internet: Both devices need internet access; they do not need the same Wi-Fi network.
connection.installation: No installed V U This app is needed for the browser workflow.
connection.cables: No HDMI cable from the controlling phone or laptop is needed for the browser workflow. An existing display computer may already be cabled to the screen.

strong: Selected PDF on a TV or projector
Simple venue messages, timers, counters and QR codes
check_first: Actual display browser and internet access
Current feature availability for advanced workflows
Audience readability and exported slide layout
different_solution: Preserving slide animations through a PDF export
Offline display when neither device has internet
Automated ticketing or enterprise device management without confirming those capabilities

evidence_note: First-party product and workflow documentation, published by the V U This team. Task examples describe ways to use the product, not independent reviews or comparative benchmark results.
